items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Frank Bull was so marvelous and so warm, you know, and so personable... She said, 'Yes, Mr. Bull would like for you to come to be on the show.'

ctx.x: I was wondering if that was who it was.
My Lord, how could I ever -- Frank Bull, Frank Bull. Well, Frank Bull was a big man on KFWB.
